judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`) and a new failing acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/usageAcrossRounds.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually implementing any of the production changes. `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` still assigns `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` instead of accumulating usage across rounds, so the candidate's own tests will fail (`npm test` is broken). Furthermore, none of the required updates to `OrchestratorHooks` (`totalUsage`), `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, or `CHANGELOG.md` were made. The test cases written in `usageAcrossRounds.acceptance.test.ts` do accurately reflect the issue's scenarios, though the reference added them directly to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
